mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The relationship is continuous and does not require a threshold condition.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 247 signals accelerating inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL > 247, the average 20-day forward return is positive or not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 1.25% and Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 247.14 signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When FEDFUNDS > 1.25 and CPIAUCSL > 247.14, the average 20-day forward return is positive or not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%), a rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 3.5% signals an impending economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In periods when UNRATE < 3.5% and UNRATE > 3.5%, the average 20-day forward return is positive or not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1100 thousand units signals a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When HOUST < 1100, the average 20-day forward return is positive or not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 104.5 index points signals a weakening economy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When INDPRO < 104.5, the average 20-day forward return is positive or not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.2% signals immediate labor market stress, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE > 4.2, the average 5-day forward return is positive or not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real GDP (GDPC1) below 17150 billion dollars (chained 2017) signals an impending recession, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: When GDPC1 < 17150, the average 60-day forward return is positive or not statistically significant (p>0.05) over a 3-year rolling window.
